name: humanize
description: Detects and removes the tells of AI-generated writing in English and Dutch, or keeps them out while drafting: a consolidated catalog (negative parallelism, colon reveals, rule of three, em-dash density, hollow intensifiers, promotional and vague-attribution content, chatbot artifacts, and for Dutch the translationese layer of English-shaped Dutch), a register-aware procedure with fact and voice protection, and a dependency-free regex scanner for CI.
